label: DA-9701 for Gastrointestinal Symptoms in Postural Orthostatic Tachycardia Syndrome: A Randomized Pilot Study.
summary: : Patients with postural tachycardia syndrome (POTS) commonly experience gastrointestinal (GI) symptoms. We aim to assess the feasibility and preliminary efficacy data for DA-9701, a prokinetic agent targeting 5-hydroxytryptamine 1A, 5-hydroxytryptamine 4, and dopamine D : In a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, single-center crossover trial, patients with POTS were given either 30 mg of DA-9701 or a placebo 3 times daily for eight weeks in a 1:1 ratio.
